building_runtime_policy.primary: BridgePoint property-linked building geometry returned by bridgepoint_3d_world_viewport_v1899
building_runtime_policy.coverage_fallback: Overture source-native building/building_part PMTiles streamed by visible tile only
building_runtime_policy.priority_rule: When the viewport already contains a healthy BridgePoint property-linked building set, hide the source-native fallback rather than double-rendering it.

truth_rules: Never synthesize exact parcel, roof, road, rail, terrain or hazard geometry.
Source-native building footprints remain attributed to their public source and are not represented as BridgePoint-owned measurements.
A building height supplied by source data may be rendered as source height; floor-count height is labeled derived; missing height uses only a display default and is never labeled exact.
Never label forecast/alert context as observed property damage.
Keep partial building-card truth visible if enrichment times out.
Selection may add glow/outline but must retain intelligence color.
Weather refresh may not reset camera or selected structure.
historical_regressions_blocked: building detail card blanking on timeout
fake point weather instead of source geometry
bulk nationwide building download during interactive world startup
